budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: STW-S81c-HEAD-TILE 10-21 clock-structural fallback of R6 (22a89b512 RTL, native32 split, byte-identical sources; outline 648 x 648 = H10 die tile reserve, macro lattice unchanged). R5f synth: ~126k flops on ONE TritonCTS root over 648 um (gate WARN clock_span; 8x the 15k/root guidance; no head tile ever reached CTS). Here the ck port net is split by placed-sink 2-D k-means into 16 regional clock roots (physical/common_flow/clock_split_km.tcl, closed precedent dscoll_lane_w_s12h K32 at 725.8 x 583.2): one BUFx24 local root per region (~7875 sinks, ~162 um span), CTS builds one short tree per region under a balanced top tree; leaf groups 16 sinks / 24 um. Same port, clock, flops, constraints, cycles and pins; one external clock root (die binding unchanged). Pin flops at faces (io_flop_at_pins) join their face regions.
